sfx.tooltip.change_amount_297c87: How far a variation may move from the source sound, from 0.05 to 1. Low stays close to the source; 1 ignores it. Blank uses 0.9.
sfx.tooltip.describe_the_sound_16bb4b: Describe the sound you want, including its source, texture, timing, and surroundings.
sfx.tooltip.duration_d4c749: Choose the target length for the generated sound effect.
sfx.tooltip.duration_in_seconds_388a7b: Set a custom length in seconds (1 to 380). It replaces the Duration preset above.
sfx.tooltip.generation_steps_4a49ea: Set a custom number of generation steps. This overrides the quality preset above.
sfx.tooltip.quality_cb7fbe: Choose how many generation steps to use. Medium is tuned for 8 steps, so Draft is faster and Detailed takes longer without always sounding better.
sfx.tooltip.replace_from_seconds_8277f9: Where the part to regenerate starts, in seconds from the beginning of the source sound.
sfx.tooltip.replace_to_seconds_a687f5: Where the part to regenerate ends. It must be after the start and inside the sound duration.
sfx.tooltip.seed_d07208: Enter a whole number to repeat a render: the same prompt and settings with the same seed gave an identical sound in tests. Leave it blank for a random seed, which Forge records with the sound.
sfx.tooltip.start_from_an_existing_sound: Begin from a sound already in a project: make a variation of it, replace one part of it, or continue it. Forge copies the sound when you choose it. Replace and Continue re-render the whole sound, so the part you keep follows the source closely but is not an exact copy.
